variants: OpenTelemetry bridge with the official noop provider

gate.name: OBSERVABILITY_PASS
basis: base, noop and SDK paths measured with five samples
zero allocations in every measured path
default path remains process-local and exporter-free
external SDK cost is reported separately from the default path

limitations: The benchmark measures metrics observation and excludes MCP transport, graph traversal, serialization and exporter I/O.
ManualReader is an SDK aggregation path, not a network exporter or collector.
No numeric overhead threshold is specified by TASKS.md or PLAN.md; the ratios are evidence for this gate, not a release SLO.
The result is one Linux amd64 run on the recorded CPU and must be repeated on target hardware for release decisions.
